originalFindings.message: Fast refresh only works when a file only exports components — 'AuthContext' is a non-component export in a file that also defines components.
originalFindings.explanation: React Fast Refresh (Vite) and Metro (Expo/React Native) hot-swap a module by replacing its component exports. A module that mixes component definitions with non-component exports cannot be hot-swapped: edits fall back to a full reload, and every component in the module tree loses its state.

remediation.summary: Move 'AuthContext' and any other non-component exports into their own module, or move the component definitions into a separate file.
remediation.llmPromptHint: Move 'AuthContext' and any other non-component exports into their own module, or move the component definitions into a separate file.

originalFindings.message: propTypes on 'AuthProvider' are ignored in React 19.
originalFindings.explanation: React 19 removed propTypes checking entirely — the declarations remain but no validation ever runs, so invalid props pass silently.

remediation.summary: Move the constraints into TypeScript types (or a runtime schema validator) and delete the propTypes.
remediation.llmPromptHint: Move the constraints into TypeScript types (or a runtime schema validator) and delete the propTypes.

testCases.description: should render or load without crashing
